headline: **MLB Daily Recap: August 11, 2026**
article:
The Boston Red Sox fell short in Toronto, dropping a 1-2 decision to the Blue Jays. Charles McAdoo led the offense with a home run and an RBI, while Jameson Taillon pitched 4.0 innings with 3 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

Several key players are dealing with injuries, impacting their teams' lineups and rotations. The San Francisco Giants placed catcher Daniel Susac on the 10-day injured list due to a left knee patella fracture. The Colorado Rockies, Texas Rangers, Los Angeles Angels, New York Mets, Philadelphia Phillies, Tampa Bay Rays, and Milwaukee Brewers also reported injuries to Tyler Freeman, Nathan Eovaldi, Shaun Anderson, Devin Williams, Caleb Kilian, Griffin Jax, and Cooper Pratt, respectively.

The Kansas City Royals made a notable trade, acquiring first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins. The Athletics also traded for right-handed pitcher Seth Johnson from the Philadelphia Phillies, while the Miami Marlins traded right-handed pitchers Lake Bachar and received right-handed pitcher Brandan Bidois, left fielder Brian Sanchez, and infielder Hyun Seung Lee in return. The Colorado Rockies traded right-handed pitcher Victor Vodnik to the Miami Marlins for first baseman Connor Norby and right-handed pitcher Aiden May.

top_news.summary: The Boston Red Sox dropped a 1-2 decision to the Toronto Blue Jays, with Charles McAdoo leading the offense with a home run and an RBI. Jameson Taillon pitched 4.0 innings with 3 strikeouts and 0 earned runs.

top_news.title: **Mets Take Down Braves in Thrilling 8-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The New York Mets secured an 8-5 win over the Atlanta Braves, with Brett Baty leading the offense with a home run and four RBIs.

top_news.title: **Twins Take Down Orioles in 5-9 Thriller**
top_news.summary: The Minnesota Twins secured a 5-9 victory over the Baltimore Orioles, with Josh Bell leading the Orioles' offense with 2 hits, 1 home run, and 3 RBIs. Dean Kremer pitched 7 strong innings for the Orioles, striking out 7 and allowing just 1 earned run.

top_news.title: **Phillies Edge Cardinals in Thrilling 6-5 Victory**
top_news.summary: The Philadelphia Phillies secured a hard-fought 6-5 win over the St. Louis Cardinals, with Andrew Painter earning the win.

top_news.title: **Giants Place C Daniel Susac on 10-Day Injured List**
top_news.summary: San Francisco Giants catcher Daniel Susac has been placed on the 10-day injured list due to a left knee patella fracture. The injury occurred on August 10, 2026.

top_news.title: **Berry Joins Royals in Trade**
top_news.summary: The Kansas City Royals acquired first baseman Jacob Berry from the Miami Marlins on August 5, 2026. Berry is now a member of the Kansas City Royals.
